name: Mossback Warden
text: When an adjacent ally is attacked, you may become the target instead.
flavor: It has slept under the same hill for four hundred years, and it is not done yet.

name: Archivist of Ash
text: **Recall:** Look at the top three cards of your deck. Put one in your hand and the rest on the bottom.

name: Fallen Paladin
text: Your other allies with Discipline get +1 Armor. Once per turn, when an ally falls, heal 2.
flavor: The oath still binds him. He just no longer remembers to whom.

name: The Hollow Sage
text: At the start of your turn, each opponent discards a card at random.

name: Wildfire Chorus
text: Counts as every Aura. When this enters play, copy the last action you took this turn.

name: Plague Rat Swarm
text: When this deals damage, the target is Sickened.
